FormatVersion.description: Plug public serialized contracts. 0.2-alpha.1 replaces 0.1-alpha.2; migrate older documents with migrateInput.

Quantity.description: Nonnegative, bounded finite measurement in the field's documented units.

Fraction.description: A probability, never a percentage in the 0–100 range.

Ordinal.description: Ordinal trade-off level: 0 none, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high.

kind.description: `static` facts are parsed from local code, configuration or contract files. `probed` facts were measured by a bounded, author-authorized local probe; they describe that workbench vantage and are never production verification. `judged` facts are model judgments pinned to their exact inputs; they qualify a verdict and are never production verification.

source.description: Where the fact came from, e.g. a workspace-relative file path.

Evidence.description: Each operational fact carries provenance; unknown values must be null.

keyDimensions.description: All output-changing dimensions, including identity where scoped.

reversible.description: Completed effects have a domain inverse or compensation.

idempotencyKeySupported.description: The operation accepts a caller-supplied idempotency key.

Interaction.description: How a later result can reach the caller.

RequestBinding.description: A bounded request recipe. Header values may reference `${env:NAME}` and those environment values are resolved only at execution time.

ResponseBinding.description: How a response is projected into the data and source-time used by a runner. JSON pointers are RFC 6901 pointers; null leaves that field unavailable.

Messaging.description: Delivery behavior of the channel through which this system is reached. `none` means synchronous request-reply.

operations.description: Operations this system exposes or calls.

trustDomain.description: Identity/trust domain; differing domains cross a trust boundary.

availability.description: Fraction of calls that succeed within the timeout.

burstPerMinute.description: Peak request rate within any one minute.

trace.description: Bounded ordered trace; replay starts cold at time zero.

measurementStartMs.description: Count only requests at/after this time; warmup remains visible in the report.

usableHitObservation.description: Matching observations bind to the exact policy fingerprint.

hitsWithinTarget.description: Independently justified complete-path probability for hits.

hitsWithinTargetMs.description: Latency threshold to which the hit probability evidence applies.

directWithinTarget.description: Optional complete-path evidence for direct calls at the specified threshold.

completePathBoundMs.description: Independently declared complete-path hard bound for everyRequest.

initialOutput.description: Optional independently available useful initial result. Acknowledgements do not qualify.

priorities.description: Distinct lexicographic ranking order applied after hard constraints.

firstAckMs.description: Budget for a first acknowledgement; an acknowledgement is not useful output.

silenceBudgetMs.description: Longest acceptable period without any feedback.

Experience.description: Required experience and interaction goal. Absent optional requirements mean none was declared.

deliveryAllowanceMs.description: Bounded delivery allowance used in age eligibility, separate from point latency.

SemanticEquivalence.description: A recorded judgment that the declared output meaning satisfies the required useful output. It binds to the exact judged strings: when either changes, the judgment is void and the strict comparison applies again.

AdoptedArchitecture.description: An architecture choice explicitly adopted by the author. The engine re-verifies the pattern set against every new input and catalog version.

Connection.description: One caller-to-downstream connection with its own facts and goal.

connections.description: Connections may share systems and operations.

RelationPredicate.description: Names of the derived pairwise predicates.

RelationFact.description: Three-valued predicate: null means unknown, never false.

runtimeCoupling.description: Remaining runtime coupling to the downstream; null leaves coupling unchanged.

template.description: Seed designs carry their detailed evaluator template.

requiresOneOf.description: At least one must hold when nonempty.

PatternDefinition.description: A pattern as versioned, machine-readable knowledge.

ObligationDefinition.description: An obligation a pattern introduces; any holding condition discharges it.

origin.description: `planned` comes from bounded composition; `adopted` was checked on demand.

ArchitectureCandidate.description: A closed pattern stack built on one seed base design.

adoptedArchitectureId.description: Author-adopted design when it remains valid under this exact analysis.

policyDecisionNeeded.description: Two or more feasible frontier architectures tie on every declared priority.

input.description: Canonical input; importers re-validate it and reconcile it with the task list.

design.description: The analysis exported with the workflow, only when it was computed for this exact input.

WorkflowSpecMetadata.description: Plug data under `document.metadata.plug` of an exported Open Workflow Specification document.

WorkflowTaskMetadata.description: Plug data under `metadata.plug` of each exported call task.

SourceResponse.description: Fixed trusted-local HTTP response envelope; data is checked against the selected output contract.

AuthorizedHost.description: A host the author added to the local workbench. The value is an origin (`scheme://host[:port]`), never a URL containing credentials or a path.

ProbeEvent.description: One append-only event from a bounded local integration probe.

OperationManifest.description: Bounded measurements for one operation from one local-workbench vantage.

VerificationRecord.description: A bounded workbench demonstration pinned to an exact spec and design.

root.description: Directory name only; absolute paths are never serialized.

fingerprint.description: Hash of scanned relative paths and contents, used for freshness.

system.description: Draft description for review; null when no operation was found.

WorkspaceIndex.description: Structural facts from a bounded local scan. Operational facts remain unknown and are listed in gaps.
